decisions.reason: As a highly visible automation robot at the core of the firm's announced future-ready precast strategy, management is likely to justify prior engineering and market commitment by keeping it on the market.

The profile storage robot is less central than the flagship robots but still complements the firm's integrated automation portfolio, so sunk development and system-completeness motives favor retention.

Although overlap with the combined robot raises rationalization pressure, management would still tend to keep the automatic shuttering robot because it extends the modular range and abandoning it would concede an earlier commitment.
As a newly introduced machinery line with several models, it likely embodies substantial recent investment and public commitment, which makes an early withdrawal unlikely.

The production analysis software is close to the established offer and supports the automation direction, so management is inclined to continue it while attributing any weak uptake to an early-market phase rather than failure.
